'''Jenth''' was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|human]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. A [[Youngling/Legends|child]] of young age, Jenth had fair skin, short [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Like all enslaved [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], Jenth was named after a letter in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet&mdash;namely, the letter [[Jenth/Legends|Jenth]]&mdash;and had the shape of the letter [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on their face. Jenth was brood mates with fellow enslaved Force-sensitives [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] and [[Herf (Infinite Empire)|Herf]], and all four were among those who were used to power the machines of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species that ruled the Infinite Empire. Xesh's earliest memories was him, Jenth and the rest of the brood mates huddling together for warmth.<ref name="DOTJ 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jenth was first shown in a flashback scene from [[Tau (individual)|Xesh's]] past in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1]]'', the first issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|The Prisoner of Bogan]]'' story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series.<ref name="DOTJ 6" />
